findings.message: Helm will delete Namespace/default/eclipse-che. Every object in that namespace is deleted with it.

The CRD checlusters.org.eclipse.che under crds/ changed (the file contents changed). Plain Helm does not upgrade CRDs in that directory. helm upgrade leaves the CRD already in the cluster as it is, and CRDs are not installed on upgrade or rollback.
Role/default/che-operator adds rules. Flags: pods/exec, wildcard.

The pod template of Deployment/eclipse-che/che-operator changed at spec.template.spec.containers[name=che-operator].env[name=CHE_VERSION].value. The pods will restart. A restart is normal for an upgrade.
